editorial:
Imagine a wealthy family in a big German city who looks perfect from the outside. You get the feeling that everything is great until you look closer. You meet the Bergers, a family with plenty of money but zero peace. The real drama is between the father and his son, Martin, who just cannot get along. Things get messy when Martin meets a girl named Britta. He falls for her hard, but their relationship is more of a disaster than a romance. The vibe is heavy and tense, making you feel the pressure of trying to keep up a fake image while your personal life is falling apart.

What really hits you is how the tension builds until it finally snaps. The acting is solid, and the way the plot twists when Martin discovers his father's secret is a huge shock. While some parts feel a bit slow, the dark turn at the end keeps you glued to the screen. If you enjoy old-school dramas with a dark edge, you should definitely give this one a try. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or look for a high-quality Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best experience.
endingExplained: The movie ends in total tragedy. After Martin finds out his father was also sleeping with Britta, he snaps. He kills Britta in a fit of rage and anger. He does not stop there and also kills his friends who lived wild lives. The story wraps up by showing the total destruction of the family. It proves that their fancy lifestyle was a lie and that their hatred for each other led to a bloody end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic family dramas and dark psychological stories.
